name: Clipform
description:
Clipform turns a conversation into an interactive, video-first form. Describe the quiz, survey, feedback form, or sign-up you want, and Claude builds it in your Clipform workspace - questions, options, scoring, answer feedback, an end screen, and a shareable link - in one go. Respondents can reply by video, audio, or text, which lifts completion and gives you richer answers than a plain web form.

Ask for changes in plain language: add or reword a question, reorder the flow, change settings, publish or unpublish. Then ask what came in - response counts, per-option breakdowns, and recent open-text replies - without leaving Claude.

What you can do:
- Build a form in one message from a mix of steps: multiple choice, open text (video, audio, or typed), contact details, buttons, links, file downloads, and an end screen
- Create scored quizzes that show respondents whether they got each answer right
- Import an existing public Google Form as a draft, then rebuild it video-first
- Edit any form conversationally: add, update, delete, and reorder questions; change titles, settings, and publish status
- Read results: totals, per-option breakdowns, and individual text responses filtered by time

Great for quizzes, feedback surveys, contact and sign-up forms, and video testimonial requests - anywhere a conversation converts better than a static form.

Your workspace, plan limits, and existing forms are always respected, and deleting a form or question asks you to confirm first. Requires a Clipform account, free to start.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Clipform to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Clipform to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.clipform.io/forms. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Clipform MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clipform lists 15 MCP tools, including clipform_add_node, clipform_create_form, clipform_delete_form, clipform_delete_node, clipform_get_form, clipform_get_guide, clipform_get_responses, clipform_get_results, clipform_get_workflow, clipform_import_form, clipform_list_forms, and clipform_set_logic.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Clipform?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Clipform in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Clipform requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Clipform is developed by Clipform. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
